title: Analyze Gap Research — Cognitive Level Classification Audit
read_only_attestation: Zero files modified. All data from grep/Select-String and direct file reads.

clone_analysis.clone_pattern_description: All 48 clone items follow DL-012 pattern: same stem skeleton, different company name only. Stem describes a concept; answer is the TERM for that concept. These are Remember/Understand definition-matching items — NOT genuine Analyze. The word 'analyzes' in the stem refers to what the fictional company is doing, not what the candidate must do.

genuine_analyze_estimate.describe: After removing 48 definition-match clones and retaining 18 genuinely unique Analyze-labeled items, plus identifying misclassified items from Apply/Understand:

confirmed_misclassified_apply_to_analyze.stem: Delta's flexible budget for 8,000 units shows budgeted variable costs of $64,000. Actual output was 8,000 units with actual variable costs of $70,000. What does this variance indicate?
confirmed_misclassified_apply_to_analyze.rationale: Candidate must INTERPRET the meaning of an unfavorable variance at constant output — pure analysis. No formula application required.

confirmed_misclassified_apply_to_analyze.stem: Eastwood investigates any budget variance exceeding 5% of budgeted cost or $10,000, whichever is smaller. A department shows a $9,000 unfavorable variance on a $150,000 budget. Should this be investigated?
confirmed_misclassified_apply_to_analyze.rationale: Candidate must apply dual criteria, evaluate which threshold is binding, and make a decision. This is analysis, not rote application.

confirmed_misclassified_apply_to_analyze.stem: Grayson's cost analyst distinguishes between a learning curve and an experience curve when discussing declining unit costs. What is the key difference between these two concepts?
confirmed_misclassified_apply_to_analyze.rationale: Candidate must compare/contrast two related but distinct concepts. Analysis (breaking down, differentiating). No computation.

confirmed_misclassified_understand_to_an.stem: Evergreen worries ROI discourages managers from accepting profitable projects above the required return but below current ROI. Which response is most appropriate?
confirmed_misclassified_understand_to_an.rationale: Candidate must diagnose WHY ROI creates this dysfunction and identify residual income as the solution. Requires analyzing ROI's behavioral effects on decision-making.

confirmed_misclassified_understand_to_an.stem: Keystone finds employees retain access after changing departments. Which response is most appropriate?
confirmed_misclassified_understand_to_an.rationale: Candidate must identify this as an access control/segregation-of-duties weakness from a scenario. Requires analyzing the control gap, not just recalling a definition.

borderline_items.stem: Iris paid a terminated employee for two pay periods. Which response is most appropriate?
borderline_items.rationale: Recognizing payroll control weakness from scenario. Borderline Understand/Analyze — depends on distractor complexity.

borderline_items.stem: Frontier produces more output with the same labor hours. Which response is most appropriate?
borderline_items.rationale: Identifying productivity improvement from output/input ratio. Borderline Understand/Analyze.

borderline_items.stem: Granite notices managers split purchases to avoid approval limits. Which response is most appropriate?
borderline_items.rationale: Recognizing circumvention of internal controls. Borderline Understand/Analyze.

separate_issue_computational_mislabeled_.description: 47 items asking 'What is...' / 'How much...' / 'Calculate...' labeled Understand but should be Apply. Separate error from the Analyze gap.

How much overhead is applied to the job?

structural_gap_assessment.verdict: MIXED — Primarily CLASSIFICATION with significant STRUCTURAL component

classification_gap: 72.7% of items labeled 'Analyze' (48/66) are definition-matching clones — they test TERM RECOGNITION, not analysis
4 confirmed Apply->Analyze + 3 Understand->Analyze + 8 borderline items found in 15-item sample
47 computational items labeled 'Understand' should be 'Apply' — systematic template labeling error
Template pipeline assigned CognitiveLevel by rotation-group position, not cognitive demand
Packs C and D show most severe bias: entire rotation groups share one CognitiveLevel
structural_gap: Genuine Analyze items: ~33 (1.32%) vs. CAQS target 625 (25%) — gap of 592 items
Pool designed via template authoring that produces definition-matching + formula-application items
Section A has ZERO Analyze items despite being the domain richest in judgment scenarios
No item asks candidates to IDENTIFY PATTERNS, DIAGNOSE CAUSES, or EXPLAIN WHY a variance occurred
'Which response is most appropriate?' format could test analysis but choices default to definition matching

A.note: WORST gap. ~185 items, all scenario-based. Many stems could test analysis if choices required judgment.

B.note: Pack D has 7 definition-match clones. Pack B has 2 (high-low = Apply; ideal vs practical = borderline Analyze). Pack A has 2 confirmed misclassifications (B-036/B-039).

C.note: Highest labeled count (24) but 19 are clones. Only C-018 and C-064 approach analytical thinking.

D.note: Pack D D-032 (DOL) is concept question. Pack C D-017-021 are clones. Relevant costing/make-or-buy/special-order items are completely absent from Analyze.

E.note: BEST Analyze items in pool: Pack B Section E COSO/ERM/SOX scenario questions. Genuinely analytical — apply framework knowledge to situations.

F.note: Pack A (ETL, RPA — borderline). Pack B (AI/ML, cybersecurity, SOC — borderline). Pack C clones.

recommendations.detail: Recode P1-B-036, P1-B-039, P1-B-061: Apply->Analyze. Recode P1-C-011, P1-E-040: Understand->Analyze.
All 48 DL-012 clones labeled Analyze are Remember/Understand level. Will REDUCE labeled count but fix structural issue.
Items computing variance, overhead, etc. labeled Understand. Fix to Apply. Separate from Analyze gap.

Need ~580 genuine Analyze items. Focus areas: variance interpretation/diagnosis, ratio analysis/trend interpretation, cost behavior analysis, internal control weakness identification, make-or-buy/special-order decisions, budget variance root-cause analysis.
Root cause: template assigns CognitiveLevel by rotation-group position. Future content needs per-item cognitive assessment.

recommendations.action: Add CognitiveLevel validation rule to validator
recommendations.detail: Flag: (a) computation stems labeled Understand, (b) analytical stems labeled Understand/Apply, (c) definition-matching stems labeled Analyze.

methodology_notes.inventory_method: Select-String for CognitiveLevel count; -Context for stem/section; Node.js direct reads for per-item verification
methodology_notes.sample_size: 15 items individually classified; 5 confirmed misclassifications; 8 borderline
methodology_notes.clone_detection: Grouped by topic pattern and stem similarity within packs
methodology_notes.limitations: Pack B Section field extraction unreliable (JSON field ordering). Per-section counts for C/D derived from topic prefix.
